bios_path.description: Path to the Sega Saturn BIOS file (ROM image). If null, the emulator may use internal BIOS or require a game.

iso_path.description: Path to the game disc image file (ISO or BIN/CUE format).

cdrom_device.description: Path to the physical CD-ROM device node (e.g., /dev/cdrom).

binary_path.description: Path to a homebrew binary file to load into memory.

binary_address.description: Alternative load/run address for the binary file (e.g., '0x06004000'). Used only if binary_path is set.

fullscreen_enabled.description: If true, starts the emulator in fullscreen mode.

no_sound_enabled.description: If true, disables sound output by setting the sound core to dummy.

autoframeskip_enabled.description: If true, enables automatic frame skipping or limiting.

no_bios_enabled.description: If true, uses the emulated BIOS instead of loading a BIOS file. Mutually exclusive with bios_path in typical usage.

autostart_enabled.description: If true, automatically starts emulation when the program launches.

autoload_slot.description: The savestate slot number to automatically load when starting. Used in conjunction with autostart.
